notes.title: July 2025 Update Newsletter
notes.content: [p]Hello, everyone. This update newsletter comes a bit later than I wanted, but better late than never! We have a good handful of things to show off this time around, including a new enemy, some sketches, and other little improvements.[/p][p]Firstly, I want to introduce the new chicken coup map! There will actually be chickens here, and you can even feed them![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/58ac0612fa7b0eddea6ccc0675615713d7f4bbc8.gif"][/img][/p][p]But that won't be all. Someone or something has to guard these chickens from opportunistic foxes. How about a bigger and angrier chicken?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/3411db325448d89e25e4f12165e342dfbfd7891f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/ad1e9a04095d893c3d70f9630620376b712648e1.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/71d2928b5916ababc1d551353e920274f848df3f.gif"][/img][/p][p]The Chiropter will return as a guest to Fay's manor! Here's some sketches for an animatic during her dinner scene depending on a choice you make.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/6e0b8ad07429e2bbc8c414f5d9ca166f3205beda.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/45e8a9d1ed20ce430cdbcbea3c4196bc74fcb51f.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/5af6436e8210a6da4b57976b413d071dcfaaf91c.png"][/img][/p][p]I've been working on balance changes for sleepiness. You'll find that it takes longer for Henrietta to get tired. The amount you need to sleep to rid of your sleepiness has also been reduced. In light of all this, if Henri gets too tired, she'll eventually collapse! It takes about an in-game day's time from having 0 sleepiness to collapse.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/0cb3e852e95c1d4f9e5767d0865d30bf225198cd.gif"][/img][/p][p]Lastly, running leaves a little puff effect and there is a proper ladder climbing animation![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/e72c295873ba0457b83184f7ae75c6b66384df05.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/4e4ab48ecf9c9b2addfd212759aad120eb5a8943.gif"][/img][/p][p]We're still working on trying to get this new final demo set up, but we're currently having some difficulties with our new pathfinding system, which is heavily based on sectors. It will require much testing and bug-fixing at this point, so unfortunately you guys will have to keep on waiting for that Kickstarter campaign to kick off. In the meantime, I'll keep on working and refining things. Thanks for your guys' patience and support![/p]

notes.title: March 2025 Update Newsletter
notes.content:
​Hello, everyone! This newsletter is going to be a somewhat small one. Currently, I am investing more time into one of my other projects, which is very close to being done. I would say to give it about a couple months and I will have more time to put into the game! During this time, however, I will be chipping away at the Kickstarter, which I hope to submit before the other project is finished.

Anyways, here's what we got for this month.

Firstly, my programming pal Gibmaker is working on a sector-based navigation system for NPCs! We never implemented any sort of pathfinding, but now NPCs will be able to go around corners to get you (this is especially important for a particular hulking beast). Check out this psychedelic screenshot in the meantime.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/7087466622fc2593bd8698f54341cf0e5d8af0b6.png[/img]

​Have a collection of new animations for the prisoners.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/19b4711a3c768669df86d2b954f603a585bac10b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/4c3a95800704072c1ae4fe8e5e4e0fe52b0bca9d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/c1a0a14459f70dde4e1f9a9914bf2c556d8b6c45.gif[/img]

​We are currently implementing a second floor lockout on the first day. This will result in fewer maps to go through so that new players are not too overwhelmed by the size of the manor.

​[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/5ebf72a5def0f5252d4a1b7876241d2d5786c75e.gif[/img]

Two new dinner guests are being worked on!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/0f2cb463495113e81ae3e6976e83506bd1145a00.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/046125990c28592eedaff0bf7a957077a8606803.png[/img]

Thank you for reading! Again, I am dead focused on this other project, so don't expect any newsletters for the next couple months. That being said, we will be sure to let you know when we make headway on the Kickstarter campaign!

notes.title: February 2025 Update Newsletter
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! We've got a short little newsletter for you all this month. In January, we've mostly focused on a new means of strengthening weapons and the Carniflora enemy!

---

Before we get into that, though, check out the [b]newest source of light[/b]! If you can get your hands on the [b]Lantern[/b], it will be quite nice to have, as it does not go out by running and rolling, unlike the torch! The only issue is that you won't be able to light torches with it, so that will still have some utility.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/b5b2b92626a5584376dd8076b7d76610d7d9031d.gif[/img]

You might have seen Henrietta digging out a peculiar ore in the previous newsletter. There are several ores like this, all with different colors. Get your hands on these [b]Vivid Ores[/b] and turn them into Ingots as you would normally do. Fluke specializes in using such ores to permanently strengthen whatever weapon you please! Each ore has a different buff they can apply to your weapon:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/1cd3581fa41f0f17adbd6685982677953e43e0aa.png[/img]

- Red Ore: Increase attack power.
- Purple Ore: Less stamina used.
- Orange Ore: More gems dropped on kill.
- Blue Ore: More essence dropped on kill.
- Green Ore: More stun on hit.

Quite valuable and worth doing, I'd say! Just make sure you got the proper amount of coin!

Lastly, let's go over some catches to the Carniflora!
These bestial plants will only be found outside, like in the demo (but not in the courtyard this time!). At night time, lack of sunlight will cause them to curl up into a deep [b]slumber[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/65411d58534d22c4d16b2ea1267272519e3ccc9c.gif[/img]

Adding to that, when a Carniflora is killed, there is a chance its head will sprout legs of its own to continue attacking you! Don't be caught off guard, it's a ferocious, jumpy little fruit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/faf1318702e6dfa9c99e50e8ad13626b9f20fdc9.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/3b42beed9463c27be6769b278104805f9e3377c1.gif[/img]

That's it for this month, thanks for reading and have a good start to March!

notes.title: January 2025 Update Newsletter
notes.content:
​​Hello, everyone, hope you all had a good start to your New Year! We don't have too much to show this month, as I've been mostly working on tilesets, maps, as well as inching towards getting our upcoming Kickstarter campaign going! The latter is going to take a while longer since I'm also trying to conceive a way to update our demo to the current build (I want to push this at the same time as the Kickstarter). Doing so, however, will require us to rethink how much of the game people can play in the demo. It's really tricky to figure out because of our gameplay loop, but we're currently considering letting people play until they first reach 6AM and faint from Fay's curse. I'm SO sure that no one can beat the game in that amount of time! (haha)

Anyway, here's the little we got to show you guys!

​-----

When you show Lady Fay that you're willing and able to get stuff done, she will take notice, and you will be invited for dinner! No, don't worry, you aren't the dinner this time. You have the honor of eating with her! This is the perfect time to have conversation and learn more about certain characters. After dinner, you'll be rejuvenated as well, receiving health as a bonus as well as more approval from Fay! The video shows a preview of the dinner scene and its unique music!

[previewyoutube=dhVBBfJP7XM;full][/previewyoutube]

Our campaign will feature ONE PHYSICAL REWARD! WHOA! I'm working on a cool sticker sheet with a handful of the most popular characters in the game, as well as a cursemark of your very own!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/3df707f9b1a7eca18f0c196616b9877d046187bf.png[/img]

More outdoor environments are in-work, such as the graveyard...

​[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/f68df375f15dd9a1b6404182b711abec2d71b5b9.png[/img]

...and a hedge garden!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/6ed34777dc31f201d66922929d5cccccbb12823f.png[/img]

These hedge tiles took me a while to make let alone map out, and GameMaker's autotile system is not great.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/fd37b74bd6d603a5478e345434f6f3b2c077aa6a.png[/img]

Currently, we're also testing enemies spawning on day one. We've seen that people tend to want to get into the action right away. For balance's sake, minimal enemies will spawn on the first day, and then will spawn normally once you meet Fay.

And yep, that's all we got for this month, sorry! We'll see you guys again at the end of February! Have a complimentary drawing I did as a result of a poll held in the Discord.

​[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/fdc162727739e048a5a2e9433620ed0054b63ff6.png[/img]

notes.title: December 2024 Update Newsletter
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! Hope you all had a happy Holiday season! We're back with some more updates. (We've also updated the demo version!)

Firstly, we want to introduce the third prisoner of the manor, [b]Matteus[/b]! This big dog carries a positive lax attitude always, even in the face of imprisonment! He's a machine in the kitchen and is known around his settlement for his skill in using the perfect blend of spices and herbs to make his dishes among the most savory and delicious in the continent. Perhaps Fay brought him over for his expertise and to have him dabble in the unique fauna and flora in the copse?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/7d3af2911f64b73dacc70124ec18159937c37b3b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/40c53d45c3696f0ca758c5ddb57bac2da3ffd795.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/6a56f10e31bd0a6ac9278846826f5c7a8ed3e2a1.png[/img]

When you get your hands on the [b]shovel[/b], digging mounds will be possible, and this could yield unique items you won't find elsewhere! A certain raccoon boy might have one on hand that you can use~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/0e549ea11d955565f2ecc610b0ca9091c64e5f70.gif[/img]

People have asked for more [b]Fay[/b]. Be careful what you wish for! >:) You can randomly encounter her throughout the day, the witch expecting an offering from you. You can simply give it to her and get a boost in approval, or refuse and lose approval! You could also attempt to negotiate. Either she will take the item anyway or take another random item in your inventory!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/9f4be35e37f6448c1ae9adfb004f4af2219f5995.gif[/img]

Here are some other cool things you can get from the outdoors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/549c52acbe3d9b0e5e359111dcb7fd2ec2b2549a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/cb16718ec8892c6611d8acf2e07134253b58d167.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/d306626a08ee12ac754ac9902841a47823be14ff.gif[/img]

Thanks for reading, and we wish you all a happy and productive start to your New Year! See you next month!

notes.title: Winter Demo Update!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! I've updated the Demo to start the limited time [b]Winter update[/b], which will last throughout December! In this update, there will be [b]presents[/b] scattered throughout the mansion. Spread some holiday cheer and offer them to the residents of the manor! Presents can be given to almost all NPCs, and you will be rewarded in turn! Enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/ed0556d7088e141f38ae773d5ef4404caf688cd8.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/18c7a1e510b391725feb55d3675bebe251380da6.png[/img]

As for regular updates, unfortunately there isn't much to show. We've been mostly working on prisoner cutscenes, the new lighting system, and other miscellaneous things that either aren't interesting enough to show or we don't wish to show them because of spoilers!

Have a merry December, and we'll see you all when the New Year hits!

notes.title: October 2024 Update Newsletter
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! This month's newsletter will be a little short because of the Fall update that we worked on, but we do have a bit of the Outside environments to show here. We don't want to give too much away, so here's a gif of Henri punching a mannequin forever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/6dbae5f10012cc6cde80947ff62f1ce918761b16.gif[/img]

In addition, here's a preview of the music composed for it. We do plan on adding some kind of ambience in the future as well.

[previewyoutube=GBfz227qgNY;full][/previewyoutube]

Next, we want to show off the next prisoner! Meet Cornelia, a rabbit who hails from a land far North. She is adept in reading and deciphering and has apparently proven useful to Lady Fay in more than one instance. She is very timid and doesn't know much of the southern side of the Province. Where she is from, the people are not often let go unless they are on pilgrimage or taking on a holy mission.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/10e2e9e4cecdccea7b924ebadd18e4d9c4acc47a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/ae084a1c2cad3e14212f16d216c40e6e61fbd604.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/c1e47e8731838221c83620dfc4f31a0624c483e4.png[/img]

Choices...matter? What you say to a prisoner could affect conversations in the future, as well as your standing with Lady Fay!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/80bee608cdf5c28f256157326da6a348b02fdd7c.png[/img]

Preview for a new puzzle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/31e4b467acaa1e5c6d30634f61615c705897affa.gif[/img]

That'll be it for now. We'll have the Fall update carry on for the remainder of the month. Hope you guys are enjoying it so far, and see ya next time!

notes.title: Demo Fall Update!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! I thought I'd make something fun for the current season that you can play now via the demo! This update is a limited one that revolves around the fall season (This event will end when [b]December[/b] hits). The foyer and courtyard have received some touch-ups to give that [b]Halloween/Fall[/b] type of mood, but even bigger than that is a new item that appears in Henrietta's cell: the [b]pumpkin[/b]!

The pumpkin is a new consumable item that is restocked in the starting cell every midnight. You can put these pumpkins on the heads of Servants, and it is said that [b]canids[/b] are especially attracted to this plump winter squash. Try attracting a certain hulking Therwolf near Servants with the pumpkins on their heads and Lady Fay might appreciate you satisfying her prowling pet beast.

Thanks for reading and enjoy the spooky season!

notes.title: September 2024 Update Newsletter
notes.content:
[b]Hello, everyone, welcome to the update newsletter for September! We have several new things to tease, check them out below:[/b]

---

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/ed5aee3324137d75b18e1db750a6f83a4870f78a.gif[/img]

[i]Nothing like a bit of caffeine to keep you up as you run across the manor desperately finishing off your last task! Outside of Stimulants, brewed with Witch Eyes, there are now cups of [b]coffee[/b] you can find in boxes and chests. They won't wake you up as well as a Stimulant, but they can keep you going in a pinch![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/5356b72cf8c20dc254439fabecdc3cd367a4c204.gif[/img]

[i]Is your stash becoming rather full? Vania now has a [b]sellbox[/b] in her shop that will allow you to put away excess items you don't need and get some money back for it![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/e5285d8f5034fe8fb053c09da49d451f86147825.gif[/img]

[i]The smelter has an extra step to produce a few items now. You must insert the appropriate [b]mold[/b] (a base for a smelted substance to be poured into to create a shape) and then the ores in order to attain things like ingots or needles. This was TOTALLY not included to put in another puzzle element elsewhere![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/b24e343ee9738024cf03e6bcba182c6d1e0f5a27.gif[/img]

[i]Who's this [b]handsome fox[/b] taking over the armory? In the final build, you won't use tokens to buy weapons; instead, give some [b]gold[/b] to this new character and he will grant them to you![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/781ff38fa4a3ec8af4b2c8d2a9c401d5147d6763.png[/img]

[i]If you've got time to kill, get with the blue jackal to play a game of [b]Magical Chests[/b], where you match two chests that have the same item! Wager some gold and get a multiplier for each round you beat![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/0d066aa3eff4b98944abbdea37197b36d9d17fd1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/f27b071c6d435e9e8e021dc33b661c6611b9a33b.png[/img]

---

[b]That is all for September, thanks for reading! I'm currently starting work on the new backyard environment, the Second Prisoner, and Leif the gardener raccoon! See you late October![/b]

notes.title: Away With the Dark! Demo Version 1.5.4 Released!
notes.content:
Hello! I present another patch, one that has a crash fix and will hopefully rid the basement halls of anymore performance issues for lower end systems.

[list]
[*] Fixed crash when player would pick up a liftable object just as an Acolyte fire pillar would burst.
[*] Improved performance greatly in the Basement Halls.
[*] Fixed potion key being able to phase through wall after breaking the bottle it's in.
[*] Fixed Froggo still grabbing you with its tongue while Stony Potion is in effect.
[*] Fixed Carniflora being able to see and attack you while you're invisible.
[*] Fixed Therwolf chasing you even while you're invisible after having stunned him.
[*] Fixed Gambeson taking damage every frame when in Therwolf's pounce.
[/list]

Thank you for playing and enjoying Mind Her Manor. I'll see you guys in the September Newsletter!

notes.title: August 2024 Update Newsletter & Demo 1.5.3 release
notes.content:
Hello, everyone! Every month, I wish to try to share a few bits of new content that we are cooking up for the final release. Some may not be as robust as newsletters in the future simply because we don't want to show too much, but we also don't want you guys to be left hanging, wondering what's going on with the project!

First, I wish to get the demo notes out of the way since we did upload a new version of it (1.5.3), fixing a handful of new issues that were brought up:

[list]
[*] Fixed crash when the Jar Sprite projectile would hit an object Henrietta is carrying.
[*] Fixed an issue where if the game was started with music volume at 0%, it would remain silent even if the volume was increased in-game.
[*] Fixed additional instance of bucket or washcloth disappearing if the other instance was picked up.
[*] Fixed issue where stamina would continue to drain if you moved around while charging a weapon after attacking while running.
[*] Fixed problem where you can roll while interacting with a door.
[*] Fixed torch staying lit after rolling if you don't have the torch selected.
[*] Fixed other items being eaten if you've been interrupted while trying to eat chicken and then proceeded to pick something up.
[*] Fixed Skull Wisp charge timer not resetting if it was stunned while charging its attack.
[*] Fixed Acolytes staying in attack phase but not doing anything after being stunned during an attack.
[*] Fixed traps displaying wrong graphic.
[*] Fixed Acolytes being able to spit player through walls.
[/list]

Now, I will briefly share some new stuff you can expect in the final release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/6cadbf744047db0791918def6059e8aa49f28f5a.gif[/img]

Some new idle states for the witch cat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/c15dcd65b9c814f357cc1747caa38b0e625fb5b3.gif[/img]

Waystones are a new item that will allow the player to set two stones down and teleport between them once. This saves invaluable time when trying to reach one end of the manor from the other!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/f683978084494f38087538ba9be4ce88ccd0689c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/4b05d7ab8192c360bdb6283b2a71a2d86cfe2d7c.gif[/img]

Leonard was teased before, but he is indeed the first prisoner to be taken by Fay and one that you can interact with. Here's a couple sneak peeks at him!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/b39c2ba36ce434d3771a3740f55fe9be8f8a3200.gif[/img]

A new animation was made for the cursemark scene!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45131141/5d97695701641c44649987c536bac390e8c8c76b.png[/img]

A chiseled blade or powerful warhammer doesn't have to be the only thing you use to defend yourself. Temporary weapons will be readily available from the start of the game! While they have much less durability and no charge attacks, they will still be nice to have in a pinch.

As for normal weapons, they will be purchased with gold rather than with tokens, which will make these kitchen tools a welcome addition to your inventory until you can afford them.

Thank you for reading, and have a good weekend! See you next month!
